examples.english: “Hearken unto me uttering the repentance for the thirteenth æon, the region out of which I have come down, in order that the thirteenth repentance of the thirteenth æon may be accomplished,--those [æons] | which I have overstepped and out of which I have come down. “2. Now, therefore, O Light of lights, hearken unto me singing praises unto thee in the thirteenth æon, my region out of which I have come down. 3. Save me, O Light, in thy great mystery and forgive my transgression in thy forgiveness. 4. And give unto me the baptism and forgive my sins”
